tools.name: list_types
tools.description: Every type the instance's schemas declare, with its tagline, its owner type and how many entities it holds.

tools.name: describe_schema
tools.description: One type's schema as the instance vendors it: file location, frontmatter fields, sections and their columns, purpose and writing rules.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: The id, canonical name and tagline of every entity of one type.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: One entity by type and canonical name: its frontmatter, sections and tables, with every reference it makes and every reference made to it. A name resolves within its type.

tools.name: find_evidence
tools.description: Everything the model says about one skill: each profile's claimed level with its Evidence verbatim, each experience that lists the skill, and any other page that references it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Entities whose name, tagline, fields, sections or table cells contain the query, case-insensitive, listed by type then name with the fields that matched. Use fetch with a result's id.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One entity by the id search returned, with its page as written. A bare name is accepted only when exactly one type holds it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
